name: HoverCard
description: A delayed preview card that springs out from a link on hover or keyboard focus, showing a user profile with avatar initials, name, bio, follower stats and join date. Open and close delays, side, alignment and a viewport collision flip are all configurable.
a11yNotes: The trigger is a real link that opens the card on hover (after openDelay) and immediately on keyboard focus; it references the card with aria-describedby while open so screen readers announce the preview. The card stays open while the pointer is over it, closes after closeDelay when the pointer leaves, on blur, and on Escape. The card is supplementary and holds no interactive content, so it never traps focus. It is portaled to document.body only after mount and copies the --mf-* theme variables from its trigger. Under prefers-reduced-motion it only fades.

defaultProps.name: Ada Lovelace
defaultProps.bio: Mathematician and writer. Publishing notes on the Analytical Engine and the first published algorithm.

propsApi.name: open
propsApi.description: Controlled open state.

propsApi.name: defaultOpen
propsApi.description: Initial open state when uncontrolled.

propsApi.name: onOpenChange
propsApi.description: Called whenever the card requests to open or close.

propsApi.name: openDelay
propsApi.description: Delay in ms before the card opens on hover.

propsApi.name: closeDelay
propsApi.description: Delay in ms before the card closes after the pointer leaves trigger and card.

propsApi.name: side
propsApi.description: Preferred side; flips when the viewport has no room.

propsApi.name: align
propsApi.description: Alignment along the trigger edge (clamped to the viewport).

propsApi.name: sideOffset
propsApi.description: Gap between trigger and card in pixels.

propsApi.name: name
propsApi.description: Profile display name; avatar initials are derived from it.

propsApi.name: handle
propsApi.description: Profile handle, also the trigger link text.

propsApi.name: bio
propsApi.description: Short profile bio.

propsApi.name: following
propsApi.description: Number of accounts followed (compact formatted).

propsApi.name: followers
propsApi.description: Number of followers (compact formatted).

propsApi.name: joinedLabel
propsApi.description: Footer line with a calendar icon; empty hides it.

propsApi.name: href
propsApi.description: Link target of the trigger; "#" prevents navigation.

propsApi.name: width
propsApi.description: Card width in pixels.

propsApi.name: accentColor
propsApi.description: Accent for the avatar gradient and trigger underline.

propsApi.name: showArrow
propsApi.description: Show the pointing arrow.

propsApi.name: children
propsApi.description: Custom card body replacing the profile content.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Class merged onto the root.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root.
